items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Durham could still play the trombone... not in the band... He arranged for the band.

ctx.x: This is where Freddie Green came in, right? He was already there? I see.
This had no interference with that because Durham could still play the trombone and double on guitar on certain special things that never was recorded, not in the band, you see.
What year was this when Ed Durham went with Glenn Miller?
